name: Global Polynomial Sum Disguise
description: Replaced the independent pairwise inequality with a global sum constraint over a carefully constructed polynomial. The polynomial evaluates to 4 if the states differ and 0 if they are the same. Thus the global sum equals 4m if and only if all coupled pairs have different states. Models that translate this directly into a backtracking solver without mathematically deducing the maximum value of the polynomial will fail to prune the search space and TLE, while SMT solvers may struggle with the non-linear global sum.
